create function checkout_report_registration_private.has_signature(p_name text,p_value jsonb)
returns boolean language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
 select coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_name),'') is not null and
 case when jsonb_typeof(p_value->'strokes')='array' then exists
 (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'strokes') x
 where case when jsonb_typeof(x)='array' then jsonb_array_length(x)>0 else false end)
 else false end,false)
$$;
